fact: The University of Cabo Verde says it is building IoT and AI water-management systems in the SSWAxC4V project and runs RS2Lab, an IoT and AI laboratory inaugurated in November 2023.

UNDP Cabo Verde Accelerator Lab says the University of Cape Verde, with Primebotics, is building AI models for smart irrigation, with a working prototype installed on the university campus and one pilot installed with three more on the way.
system: Monitoring Tools and Artificial Intelligence for Smart Agriculture

fact: The ORAL project of Universidade de Cabo Verde and Iscte, per its scientific coordinator Miguel Sales Dias, has built the largest known digital corpora of the Santiago and Sao Vicente Creole varieties and is developing Portuguese-Creole machine translation and speech recognition, with conversational assistants expected in the coming months.

A Zenodo study reports training from scratch a RoBERTa 83M-based model on crowdsourced and scraped Cape Verdean Creole corpora, which outperformed a fine-tuned Albertina 100M model at fill-mask (accuracy 68.86%), as first steps towards a Creole LLM, with experiments run on the authors' university infrastructure.

Iscte and the University of Cabo Verde, co-funded by the OEI with a total budget of 72,000 US dollars, announced the 15-month ORAL project starting 15 October, to build open Cape Verdean Creole text and speech corpora, a first Creole large language model, translation and speech recognition models, and a chatbot.
